title: Create A Beautiful World In 3 Aikido Lessons
author: Richard Moon
exact_source_text: Create A Beautiful World In 3 Aikido Lessons — a publicly offered study PDF on quantumaikido.com/books/. Aikido's path leads to harmony. Warrior spirit means taking full responsibility for our life. Living in a world beyond shame and blame, a warrior takes full responsibility for living in "accord with the universe itself". If joy is life's greatest treasure, a warrior's challenge is to bring forth sharing into the world, a joyful spirit. Love gives birth to harmony, harmony brings forth joy and joy is the greatest treasure. "Rely on Harmony, to Activate your Manifold Powers, Pacify your Environment and, Create A Beautiful World" budo is none other than the vitality that sustains all life. Enjoy Breathing Aliveness.
